scope: 04 browser click-context and consent-save correctness increment; analytics-v1 / business 1.0.5

implementation.read_gate: enabled, advertising granted, visible drama detail, pending landing; no cookie reads for unknown/denied, hidden, disabled or non-pending
implementation.validation: Five keys only, ASCII formats aligned with 05 ClickContext, at most 512 bytes per decoded value and 4 KiB per landing request; overlong, invalid and ambiguous duplicate input omitted
implementation.transport: Only existing same-origin POST /api/v1/tracking/landing click_context; tracking requests use no-referrer
implementation.persistence: No raw click identifiers in behavior events, sessionStorage or localStorage; no cookie writes, SDKs or platform requests
implementation.ordering: Pending visible consented landing is awaited before page/landing/drama events; concurrent flush waits for the same bounded confirmation. At most three landing attempts; each request timeout 5 seconds. Failure suppresses generic landing_view source confirmation and leaves URL unchanged.
implementation.cleanup: After a current-generation confirmed response, remove fbclid/ttclid from URL and existing same-origin language/sign-in return links; preserve language, other query and fragment. Late response after withdrawal cannot resume collection or clean the URL.
implementation.privacy_save: Only enabled=true and an exact policy/consent match clears the conservative block and closes the dialog. Otherwise preserve choices and dialog with retry feedback, including reopen.

verification.chrome: 13 tests passed: all existing six scenarios plus slow confirmation, advertising-only cookie access, gated no-reads, malformed inputs, failed-source ordering, consent-save mismatch and late acknowledgment after withdrawal
verification.php: Full Audience and AnalyticsContracts regression: 50 tests / 493 assertions passed
